notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1
notes.content: [h2]Changelog Patch 0.1[/h2][p][/p][h3]Improvements:[/h3][list][*][p]When you go to map scene, camera follow mode is now set as default camera mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Now you can choose to set playable window borderless yes/no.[/p][/*][*][p]Now the game use the hardware cursor mode for more perfomance.[/p][/*][*][p]Every day/night cycle now  a notification reminds you how many days remains to quest expiration.[/p][/*][*][p]Totally rebalancing of equipments and bonus/malus calculation. A New Game start it is advisable.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bugs:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed overlay bug when King sends new fresh troops.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where, for some reason, missions would not expire.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a lot of translation strings.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="67PhahfKeuI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The demo of [i]Rising Army[/i] has finally been released on Steam. I have to be honest… it hasn’t been an easy journey. Developing a strategy game on my own has often proved to be damn complicated, but I’m proud of the result achieved in this demo.[/p][p]From now on, it will be interesting to gather your feedback and critiques, and continue working on additional mechanics that will be available from the full release.[/p][p]Forward, Commanders! Deploy your finest formations![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032413/dca7fbdb10be6975b5b7602b11b4c512fb0a406d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #8 - New Battles Features
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Power indicator of two armies.
[*] When you have to deploy troops, a small icon will immediately let you know which weapon he is equipped with, and whether it is a Ranged or a Melee.
[*] ability to speed up combat with x2 or x3.
[*] GUI improvements.
[*] obstacles caused by boulders that cause the troops that have to avoid them to get stuck and slow down.
[*] zoom out at the end of the battle
[/list]

[previewyoutube=9Jth4mQWRPk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog #6 - A lot of things!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's been a month since the last Devlog and in all this time, in addition to defeating dragons and monsters from the other material plane, I've developed quite a few things on Rising Army.

Let's have a look on the new starting menu:

[previewyoutube=YbKSh8ltGBc;full][/previewyoutube]

Then i've finally developed the shop menus and recruitment system in the town's taverns :D

[previewyoutube=YaxulYYVPsU;full][/previewyoutube]

Aaaaaand... first look on epic fights!!!! ⚔️ ⚔️ ⚔️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032413/c96efb5b036b32df7f051de739911341d4416305.gif[/img]

Hoping to have a demo ready for the next [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], see you at the next devlog!

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Map exploration
notes.content:
Here's a brief overview of the exploration of the first game map in Rising Army! You can move freely; but watch out for march points! March points will limit your ability to undertake long marches, so your army will need to rest. This could be a great time to train and manage your troops!

[previewyoutube=IZ3xjBl6tp0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog #1 - WIP - Build System of your camp!
notes.content:
And here is the first devlog of [b]Rising Army[/b].

Young Commanders of the new armies of Rising Army, here is a preview of the building system for your future camp. There is still some work in progress, but the mechanics will essentially be like this. How will you manage the resources? Who will you train first? Ranged troops or close combat fighters? It will all be up to you...

[previewyoutube=5jN3faRnf6o;full][/previewyoutube]
